verdict.rationale: Okta ships an official open-source MCP server (okta/okta-mcp-server) that integrates with LLMs/AI agents to perform Okta admin operations via natural language, documented in a first-party blog post and confirmed by a probe. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party review of the MCP server's reliability, and clearer versioning/support status (GA vs experimental).
